title: Identification and Molecular Mechanism of Novel Immunomodulatory Peptides from Gelatin Hydrolysates: Molecular Docking, Dynamic Simulation, and Cell Experiments.
authors: Yu, Zhipeng; Wang, Yingxue; Shuian, David; Liu, Jingbo; Zhao, Wenzhu
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该研究鉴定明胶水解物中的免疫调节肽并解析其与TLR4-MD2蛋白的结合模式，虽用分子对接和动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-肽互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA研究无关。
abstract: The purpose of this study was to identify donkey-hide gelatin-derived immunomodulatory peptides targeting Toll-like receptor 4-myeloid differentiation 2 (TLR4-MD2) and elucidate their binding modes using physicochemical property prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vitro cell experiments. After hydrolyzing gelatin, 519 peptides were identified by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Peptides VQLSGEEK and GFSGLDGAKG bound to TLR4-MD2 with high binding affinity. In TLR4-MD2, Arg90, Ser118, Phe126, Tyr131, and Arg264 were key residues involved in the binding of these peptides. The RMSD and R(g) values demonstrated that VQLSGEEK-TLR4-MD2 and GFSGLDGAKG-TLR4-MD2 complexes had stable and compact conformations. VQLSGEEK and GFSGLDGAKG were found to increase the cell viability and phagocytic activity of RAW264.7 macrophages; significantly promote the production of cytokines TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 in cells; and inhibit the overproduction of nitric oxide (NO) and cytokines in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced RAW264.7 cells. Our results provided preliminary evidence that VQLSGEEK and GFSGLDGAKG could function as two-way immunomodulatory peptides with immunostimulatory and anti-inflammatory activities.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过理化性质预测、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及体外细胞实验，鉴定源自阿胶的靶向Toll样受体4-髓系分化因子2（TLR4-MD2）的免疫调节肽，并阐明其结合模式。水解明胶后，通过液相色谱-串联质谱法鉴定出519种肽。其中，肽VQLSGEEK和GFSGLDGAKG与TLR4-MD2具有高结合亲和力。在TLR4-MD2中，Arg90、Ser118、Phe126、Tyr131和Arg264是与这些肽结合的关键残基。RMSD和R(g)值表明，VQLSGEEK-TLR4-MD2和GFSGLDGAKG-TLR4-MD2复合物具有稳定且紧凑的构象。研究发现，VQLSGEEK和GFSGLDGAKG能增强RAW264.7巨噬细胞的细胞活力和吞噬活性；显著促进细胞中细胞因子TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6的产生；并抑制脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7细胞中一氧化氮（NO）和细胞因子的过度产生。我们的结果初步证明，VQLSGEEK和GFSGLDGAKG可作为具有免疫刺激和抗炎活性的双向免疫调节肽。
